name: com.geuneda.agentharness
description: Gives coding agents a Three.js-style loop in Unity: one command recompiles, builds or opens the scene, plays a scripted scenario and returns screenshots, console errors (file/line/module) and frame stats as JSON. Tools live in Tools~ (tools/*.ps1 in the project are thin entry points). Attach it to an existing project with Tools~/install.ps1.
